example.title: Broad Street, French Quarter, Charleston, SC (49452209906)

brief: A tall three-storey Broad Street bank block under restoration scaffolding: white stucco, a pedimented gable with a lunette, sash windows with keystones, a red-painted neighbour to the left. One photo. Older than 1970: the Charleston / New England main-street block is an 18th-19th-century type (the town's model). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
